chapter: Brother Lorenzo Tio Jr. and his career
title: Living in Bay St. Louis and the Prumwood band
summary: The family lived in Bay St. Louis, where Tio went to school, the father led a band and Lorenzo Jr. played his first parade at nine.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, uh, before I forget it, um, some people, um, Ricard Alexis was one that told us that, I believe your uncle, Louis Thiel, was over in Bay St. Louis for a while. Do you remember? Yes, we lived there a while.
The whole family? Your father too?

Yeah, my father too. We lived there a while. Well, I attended school, Portland, B. St. Louis, and my father had a band that was called the Prumwood Band. And, uh, that's when my brother played his first parade.
He played his first parade at Nine Years a Beach.
